name: Periodic traffic (daily peak, scheduled jobs, GC)
description: 5 API servers with 8 slots each handle about 2,000 rps at most. Traffic follows a daily curve (compressed to one cycle per 120 s): the peak is 1.5× normal and the trough is 0.5×. Every 60 s a scheduled job (cron) runs and all users send within the same second, so traffic is 6× for that second; the queues fill up and requests fail (about 4%). Each API server runs GC every 2 s and stops for 120 ms; the servers do not pause at the same time. Try the "cron with jitter" scenario: the same requests are spread over 10 s, and nothing fails.
